mapper.select: SELECT id, request_no, request_type, employee_id, target_department_id, applicant_id, payload_json, status, current_node, submitted_at, completed_at, created_at, updated_at FROM hr_request WHERE id = #{id} AND ( #{scopeType} = 'ALL' OR (#{scopeType} = 'DEPARTMENT' AND target_department_id = #{departmentId}) OR (#{scopeType} = 'EMPLOYEE' AND employee_id = #{employeeId}) )
